gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-comme: Glowing tubes of letter, tall in the body and short on top: Tilt Neon has a wire-like line that Comme, with its smooth modern curves, never tries to match. The result is loud above, quiet below.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-cossette-texte: Tilt Neon draws every letter like a bent glass tube, splayed at the c and generous in the lowercase. Cossette Texte then handles the plain sans job, with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height that keep the text easy to take in.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-fresca: A splayed c terminal gives Tilt Neon its swagger, with tube-like strokes that never thin out or thicken anywhere. Fresca follows in a plain sans, its open apertures and big bowls letting the loudness settle into something modern and approachable.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-funnel-sans: Glass-tube swagger, right down to the splayed c: Tilt Neon has a large x-height and short ascenders that look best big and brief. Funnel Sans takes over as a plain sans, with strokes that hold steady from stem to curve.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-gafata: Tilt Neon looks ruler-drawn, its constant-width line and splayed c giving it a bold, commanding presence that Gafata's tall band of letters and wide-eyed e shapes quietly absorb. Loud meets level-headed.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, and its words read as solid blocks. Tilt Neon, tube-like with a splayed c, is the louder voice; at modest sizes Geist is the plain sans that holds its ground.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-georama: Bold tubes with a splayed c, that is Tilt Neon, whose strokes never mix heavy and light inside a word. Georama follows as a plain sans, approachable, with a wide-open c and barely rising capitals that take the pressure off.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-gidole: Neon-tube swagger up top, with a splayed c and short ascenders on Tilt Neon's big lowercase. But Gidole carries the same tube-drawn consistency in sans-serif form, its terminals held apart like open scissor blades.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-golos-text: Bright, bold and tube-like, Tilt Neon flares its c terminal and fills the line with a large x-height. Golos Text, a contemporary sans with a widely parted s, is best given a comfortable body size so its strokes can breathe.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Tube-bent letters with a splayed c and a large x-height mark Tilt Neon, bold and commanding. Hedvig Letters Sans follows with small letters standing almost as tall as capitals, and that shared height is the pair's strongest link.
